args.sql: SELECT o.status, count(*) FROM memory.bench.orders o GROUP BY 1

WITH active_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM memory.bench.orders
),
ltv AS (
  SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(o.amount - o.discount) AS ltv_cents
  FROM memory.bench.orders o
  WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  GROUP BY o.customer_id
)
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT ac.customer_id) AS num_active_customers,
  COUNT(l.customer_id) AS num_with_completed_orders,
  AVG(COALESCE(l.ltv_cents,0)) / 100.0 AS avg_ltv_usd
FROM active_customers ac
LEFT JOIN ltv l ON ac.customer_id = l.customer_id
